The '''Damonite Yors-B system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Meridian sector/Legends|Meridian sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Damonite Yors-B]].
